# Missing NWScript routines

Routines the engine registers but does not implement: calling one logs
"Routine not implemented" and returns the default for its type. Generated by
`tools/cloud/routine_inventory.py` from `src/libs/game/script/routine/impl/*.cpp`;
regenerate it after changing a routine. A routine is missing when its function
body throws `RoutineNotImplementedException`.

## KotOR 1: 0 of 772 registered routines missing

Before tranche 1: 138 of 772 missing. Before tranche 2: 107. Before tranche 3: 93. Before tranche 4: 80. Now: 0.

## KotOR 2 (TSL): 0 of 877 registered routines missing

Before tranche 1: 203 of 877 missing. Before tranche 2: 172. Before tranche 3: 158. Before tranche 4: 145. Now: 0.

## Done: tranche 1

Pure functions and queries whose behaviour is documented. Each has tests in
`test/game/routines1.cpp`, run against K1 and K2.

`fabs`, `cos`, `sin`, `tan`, `acos`, `asin`, `atan`, `log`, `pow`, `sqrt`, `GetStringUpperCase`, `GetStringLowerCase`, `StringToFloat`, `VectorMagnitude`, `VectorToAngle`, `FeetToMeters`, `YardsToMeters`, `TurnsToSeconds`, `GetDistanceBetweenLocations`, `GetDistanceBetweenLocations2D`, `GetLockKeyRequired`, `GetLockKeyTag`, `GetLockLockable`, `GetLockUnlockDC`, `GetLockLockDC`, `GetIdentified`, `SetIdentified`, `PrintFloat`, `PrintInteger`, `PrintObject`, `PrintVector`

## Done: tranche 2

Effect subtype and duration queries, stealth XP, and faction queries. Each has tests in
`test/game/routines2.cpp`, run against K1 and K2.

`GetEffectDurationType`, `GetEffectSubType`, `MagicalEffect`, `SupernaturalEffect`, `ExtraordinaryEffect`, `GetMaxStealthXP`, `GetStealthXPDecrement`, `SetStealthXPDecrement`, `GetReputation`, `GetFirstFactionMember`, `GetNextFactionMember`, `GetFactionAverageLevel`, `GetFactionAverageXP`, `GetFactionAverageGoodEvilAlignment`

Behaviour chosen where the documentation is silent (see the tests):

- An effect value starts out magical (subtype 8) and instant until it is applied. `MagicalEffect`,
  `SupernaturalEffect` and `ExtraordinaryEffect` mark the value in place and return the same value,
  so every script variable holding it sees the new subtype.
- `GetEffectDurationType` and `GetEffectSubType` look an applied effect up among the objects of
  the current area; an effect applied elsewhere reads as unapplied.
- A faction's members are the creatures of the current area sharing its faction, dead ones
  included, in area order. `bPCOnly` (the default) keeps the player and party members.
  The averages are whole numbers (integer division) over all members, -1 for an invalid faction.
- `GetReputation` answers like `GetFactionAverageReputation`: -1 for an invalid source, 0 for an
  invalid target, otherwise the source faction's regard for the target's faction, clamped to 0..100.

## Done: tranche 3

Creature and item queries, searches around a location, encounter difficulty, transition
targets and area fog. Each has tests in `test/game/routines3.cpp`, run against K1 and K2.

`GetFortitudeSavingThrow`, `GetReflexSavingThrow`, `GetWillSavingThrow`, `GetChallengeRating`, `GetAC`, `GetWeaponRanged`, `SetGoodEvilValue`, `GetNearestObjectToLocation`, `GetNearestCreatureToLocation`, `SetEncounterDifficulty`, `GetEncounterDifficulty`, `GetTransitionTarget`, `SetAreaFogColor`

Behaviour chosen where the documentation is silent (see the tests):

- The saving throw routines return the creature's current saving throw (class bonus plus effects),
  `GetAC` its defense, `GetChallengeRating` its challenge rating; anything but a creature gives 0.
- `GetNearestObjectToLocation` takes an exact object type like `GetNearestObject`; nNth counts from 1.
- `GetNearestCreatureToLocation` takes the same criteria as `GetNearestCreature`; reputation and
  perception criteria need a creature to look from, so they never match around a bare location.
  `Area::getNearestCreatureToLocation` used to match nothing at all; it now ignores a missing target.
- `GetTransitionTarget` finds the waypoint named by a door's or trigger's LinkedTo tag in the
  current area; a transition into another module has none.
- `SetAreaFogColor` clamps each component to 0..1 and pushes the fog to the scene.

### Intentionally stubbed (29)

These return a documented default and never throw; the reason is the engine having no model
for the routine to act on. Each reason is the `intentionally stubbed:` comment in the source.

| routine | games | signature | reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CreatureFlourishWeapon` | K2 | `void CreatureFlourishWeapon(object)` | the flourish animation is not documented and no animation set names it |
| `DisplayDatapad` | K2 | `void DisplayDatapad(object)` | the engine has no datapad reader screen |
| `ExportAllCharacters` | K1+K2 | `void ExportAllCharacters()` | exports party characters to the multiplayer vault, which this engine has none of |
| `GetAreaOfEffectCreator` | K1+K2 | `object GetAreaOfEffectCreator(object)` | areas of effect keep no record of their caster |
| `GetLastAssociateCommand` | K1+K2 | `int GetLastAssociateCommand(object)` | KotOR has no associate command set (companions are not commanded by shout); answers 0 |
| `GetLastAttackMode` | K1+K2 | `int GetLastAttackMode(object)` | the engine keeps no attack mode per attack; answers 0 |
| `GetLastAttackType` | K1+K2 | `int GetLastAttackType(object)` | the engine keeps no attack type (special attack) per attack; answers 0 |
| `GetLastForfeitViolation` | K2 | `int GetLastForfeitViolation()` | no duel checks the forfeit conditions, so none is ever violated; answers 0 |
| `GetLastItemEquipped` | K1+K2 | `object GetLastItemEquipped()` | the engine raises no equip event, so no script ever runs with a last-equipped item; answers invalid |
| `GetSpellCastItem` | K1+K2 | `object GetSpellCastItem()` | spells cast from an item do not record the item for scripts; answers invalid |
| `IsInTotalDefense` | K2 | `int IsInTotalDefense(object)` | the engine has no total-defense stance for a creature to be in; always FALSE |
| `IsMeditating` | K2 | `int IsMeditating(object)` | the engine has no meditation stance for a creature to be in; always FALSE |
| `IsStealthed` | K2 | `int IsStealthed(object)` | the engine has no stealth stance for a creature to be in; always FALSE |
| `PopUpDeathGUIPanel` | K1+K2 | `void PopUpDeathGUIPanel(object, int, int, int, string)` | the death panel is the engine's own game-over flow, with no per-call button set |
| `PopUpGUIPanel` | K1+K2 | `void PopUpGUIPanel(object, int)` | the GUI_PANEL_* ids are not documented, so no panel can be chosen |
| `RandomName` | K1+K2 | `string RandomName()` | no name tables ship with the game data for it to draw on; gives an empty name |
| `SWMG_PlayerApplyForce` | K2 | `void SWMG_PlayerApplyForce(vector)` | the player moves along its track by steering only; there is no force model to push it |
| `SWMG_SetJumpSpeed` | K2 | `void SWMG_SetJumpSpeed(float)` | the swoop model has no vertical motion for a jump speed to drive |
| `SetAreaTransitionBMP` | K1+K2 | `void SetAreaTransitionBMP(int, string)` | the loading-screen picture comes from module data; the engine models no per-transition override |
| `SetAssociateListenPatterns` | K1+K2 | `void SetAssociateListenPatterns(object)` | KotOR has no associate shouts for the patterns to listen to |
| `SetCameraFacing` | K1+K2 | `void SetCameraFacing(float)` | the chase camera follows the party leader; a script cannot turn it |
| `SetCameraMode` | K1+K2 | `void SetCameraMode(object, int)` | camera modes are chosen by the engine's own camera logic; a script cannot force one |
| `SetInputClass` | K2 | `void SetInputClass(int)` | the engine has one input scheme (no controller or mouse input classes to switch between) |
| `ShowChemicalUpgradeScreen` | K2 | `void ShowChemicalUpgradeScreen(object)` | the chemical workbench screen is not wired to scripts |
| `ShowDemoScreen` | K2 | `int ShowDemoScreen(string, int, int, int, int)` | there is no demo/attract screen; reports it was not shown (0) |
| `ShowSwoopUpgradeScreen` | K2 | `void ShowSwoopUpgradeScreen()` | the swoop upgrade screen is not wired to scripts |
| `StopRumblePattern` | K1+K2 | `int StopRumblePattern(int)` | the engine has no controller rumble to stop; reports no pattern was playing |
| `SuppressStatusSummaryEntry` | K1+K2 | `void SuppressStatusSummaryEntry(int)` | the engine shows no status-summary list whose entries could be hidden |

### Still unknown

Nothing is missing. Behaviour the documentation leaves open is stated next to each routine in the
tests; the choices that deserve a second look are:

- Pattern matching (`TestStringAgainstPattern`) is anchored at the start of the text and ignores text
  after the pattern's last piece, because the documented example needs that.
- `IntToHexString` gives `0x` and eight lower-case digits (the documented example `0x0000007b`).
- Several setters (`SetHealTarget`, `SetCreatureAILevel`, `SetBonusForcePoints`, `SetFakeCombatState`,
  `SetOrientOnClick`, `SetForceAlwaysUpdate`, `SetDisableTransit`, `SetForfeitConditions`,
  `SetKeepStealthInDialog`, `EnableRain`, `SetForcePowerUnsuccessful`, `SetButtonMashCheck`) store their
  value for the matching getter, but nothing in the engine reads it yet.
- `AddJournalWorldEntry` and its siblings keep world notes in the journal; no screen lists them and saves
  do not carry them. `ModifyXSavingThrowBase` changes are not saved either.
- `GetItemComponentPieceValue` and `GetChemicalPieceValue` answer 20, the credits one workbench piece stands for.
- The `PLACEABLE_ACTION_*` values are taken as USE 0, UNLOCK 1, BASH 2, KNOCK 3.

## Notes for later tranches

- `GetDistanceBetweenLocations` and `...2D` are documented to give -1.0 for locations in
  different areas; a `Location` carries no area, so they measure every pair as one area.
- Existing routines that look wrong next to the documentation (not changed here):
  `AngleToVector` takes radians although scripts pass degrees (compare `GetFacing`, which
  returns degrees); `RoundsToSeconds` divides by 6 where a round is 6 seconds;
  `HoursToSeconds` is declared to return a float but returns an int.
- Regenerate this file with `tools/cloud/routine_inventory.py`; `--check` fails if stale.
